title: Fresh install extras import matrix
agent_persona: A packaging-focused tester checking whether optional dependency sets resolve in a clean environment.
goal: Build one wheel, install core/examples/validation/benchmarks extras in separate virtual environments, and import the expected ecosystem modules. The fragile pyscenic reference extra is intentionally excluded; use validation/reference/Dockerfile for that path.

commands.name: Build wheel once
commands.run:
python -m pip install --upgrade maturin
maturin build --release --manifest-path crates/rustscenic-py/Cargo.toml
ls -lh target/wheels

commands.name: Install extras in isolated virtual environments
commands.run:
WHL=$(ls target/wheels/rustscenic-*.whl | head -1)
for EXTRA in core examples validation benchmarks; do
  VENV="/tmp/rustscenic-extra-${EXTRA}"
  python -m venv "$VENV"
  . "$VENV/bin/activate"
  python -m pip install --upgrade pip
  if [ "$EXTRA" = core ]; then
    python -m pip install "$WHL"
  else
    python -m pip install "$WHL[$EXTRA]"
  fi
  python - <<PY
import importlib
import rustscenic
import rustscenic.grn, rustscenic.aucell, rustscenic.topics, rustscenic.cistarget
extra = '$EXTRA'
expected = {
    'core': [],
    'examples': ['scanpy', 'anndata', 'igraph', 'leidenalg'],
    'validation': ['scanpy', 'anndata', 'igraph', 'leidenalg', 'sklearn'],
    'benchmarks': ['scanpy', 'anndata', 'sklearn', 'tomotopy', 'gensim', 'psutil'],
}[extra]
for mod in expected:
    importlib.import_module(mod)
print(f'{extra}: imports OK')
PY
  deactivate
done
